/** * Basic serializer that can take JSON "Array" structure and * construct a {@link java.util.Collection} instance, with typed contents. *

* Note: for untyped content (one indicated by passing Object.class * as the type), {@link UntypedObjectDeserializer} is used instead. * It can also construct {@link java.util.List}s, but not with specific * POJO types, only other containers and primitives/wrappers. */ @JacksonStdImpl public
